objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact that goes through creation, editing, release, and archival lifecycle, subject to versioning and approval workflows.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier and title in format abbreviation_number_title

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Editing, Review, Released, Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking document revisions

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires and requires extension check

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: References, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual document content editable in Office formats

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific properties organized in categories

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with assigned roles and permissions in the document management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Read and write permissions on specific documents and related objects

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to specific authorization and distribution roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the group such as Reader, Authors, Reviewers, Releasers

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Function such as permission assignment or distribution

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document subsidiary to a main document, released with the main document and affecting its version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state matching the main document release process

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachment-specific version number

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: An uncontrolled document supplement that does not affect main document versioning or undergo release cycle approval.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating if the additional information is visible

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to a document created without affecting version history, requiring approval for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State indicating whether scheduled for implementation or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A workflow artifact created when a document reaches validity expiration threshold, requiring decision to extend or override.

attributes.name: triggered_date
attributes.description: Date when request is created, 30 days before validity expires

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A workflow artifact for declaring a document invalid and archiving it when it lacks additional validity.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the override request is created

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A workflow artifact for re-validating a previously invalidated document during the archive period.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when reactivation is initiated

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process for document approval involving multiple participants with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Process type such as Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation, Acknowledgement

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current workflow step such as Creator, Review, Release

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic confirmation and authentication by a workflow participant.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who provided the signature

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Timestamp of signature

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained set of users and groups to be notified or required to acknowledge document releases.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution method such as Email or Acknowledgement

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A storage state for invalidated or superseded documents retained for defined retention period before physical deletion.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period before archived documents are physically deleted, default 10 years

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Instantiate a new document object in the system with selected type and optional template, creating initial properties and cover.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type determining abbreviation and naming convention

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the document content using integrated Office editor with TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata organized in categories such as Master Data or Control.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Logical grouping of related properties

evts.name: convert_document
evts.description: Automatically transform document from Office format to PDF and display on web after content save.

attributes.name: output_format
attributes.description: PDF

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read and write permissions to users or groups for document and related objects based on role.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Reader, Author, Co-author, Reviewer, or Releaser

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose modifications to a document without affecting its version or content, requiring eventual approval for implementation.

attributes.name: affected_document
attributes.description: The document being proposed to change

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Trigger creation of new document version from an approved change proposal, adding note of implementation.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically authenticate completion of a workflow step by a participant with documented signature.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step being completed such as Creation, Review, or Release

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Transition a document from editing or review status to released status, automatically publishing and notifying distribution.

attributes.name: release_type
attributes.description: Initial release or revised version release

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically instantiate a new version when changes to content, attributes, or attachments require version increment.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What caused the new version such as content change or attachment modification

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Modify a released document, creating new editing version while retaining previous version data and allowing attachment archival.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Update document validity period in response to scheduled expiration, retaining current version and marking as still valid.

attributes.name: new_valid_until
attributes.description: Updated expiration date, typically 3 years from extension date

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document and attachments invalid and archived, revoking all authorizations except for archive group.

attributes.name: archive_start_date
attributes.description: When archiving period begins

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate a previously overridden document during archive period, restoring metadata, properties, and permissions.

attributes.name: new_version
attributes.description: A new version created upon reactivation

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create language-dependent version of a released document content, requiring separate approval and release workflow.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language for the translated version

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Send email notification to users or groups about document release, workflow tasks, or acknowledgement requests.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Release notice, workflow task, acknowledgement request, or status update

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Confirm receipt and understanding of a released document through workflow-supported acknowledgement without signature.

attributes.name: confirmed_by
attributes.description: User providing acknowledgement

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically generate workflow request when document reaches 30-day expiration threshold, linking document for validity check.

attributes.name: check_deadline
attributes.description: 30 days before Valid Until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow to declare document invalid and archive when it lacks additional validity during validity check.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow to re-validate an archived document, initiated only by Business Admin group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw document from active circulation by revoking authorizations, retaining in system for defined archive period.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Retention period before physical deletion

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically remove document from system after archive duration expires.

o2e.description: User initiates creation of a new document
Document is created as target artifact
User modifies document content through Office editor
User maintains metadata in property categories
Document is converted to PDF format
User with author rights creates the proposal
Change proposal is created as new artifact
Proposal references a document for modification
User approves change proposal for implementation
Document version is created from proposal
Electronic signature is created and documented
Attachments are released with main document
New version is created as result of changes
Released document is revised creating new version
System or admin notifies user via email
Notification concerns document release or status
Request is created for validity check
Document is physically removed after archive period
